evidence_quotes.quote: Assessing the Upscaling Potential of In-stream Interventions for Sustainable Urban Water Management
Informal nature-based retrofits to existing grey infrastructure networks for the purpose of improving water quality
PGI using both gravel and terracotta substrates both perform reasonably well for detaining or removing physical and biological contaminants

raw_response.plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both readings because the dissertation examines in-stream green infrastructure retrofits for stormwater and ambient receiving-water contaminant treatment rather than household or community water or sanitation service access; mentions of governance constraints and Diffusion of Innovations adoption barriers do not alter the lack of domestic service-access scope.
raw_response.rationale: This dissertation investigates Provisional Green Infrastructure (in-stream gravel and terracotta substrate retrofits) for urban stormwater and ambient drain/receiving-water contaminant removal (KBOD5, TP, Ammonia-N, TSS via SWMM 5 and TOPSIS modelling) alongside Diffusion of Innovations surveys of technology adopters. It does not examine household or community water supply or sanitation service access, legal/administrative access rules, or household service-access outcomes (E07).
